expressions.bm_casual: Boleh tak saya? / Boleh ke saya?

expressions.en: Are you free? / Do you have time?
expressions.bm_formal: Adakah anda lapang? / Adakah anda ada masa?

expressions.en: Can you repeat that? / Could you explain again?
expressions.bm_formal: Boleh anda ulang semula? / Boleh anda terangkan lagi?
expressions.bm_casual: Boleh ulang balik? / Boleh explain balik?

work.scenario: You're a new intern at a Malaysian company. You need help with a task, confirm you understand instructions from your supervisor, and subtly ask if they have time for a quick chat.

life.scenario: You're out with friends or family at a mamak stall in Malaysia. You accidentally spill a drink and apologize, then ask a friend if they are free to go shopping later, and finally ask for their help to pass the tissue.

tech.scenario: You're trying to set up a new smart home device and are on a call with technical support. You confirm you understand their initial steps, then ask them to repeat a complex instruction, and finally, ask if you can restart your router.
